history.revision: Automatically retry every failed payment.charge attempt through a bounded retry policy. Every attempt for one logical charge must reuse the caller-supplied idempotency_key, including an ambiguous TIMEOUT_AFTER_CAPTURE outcome. Before webhook settlement, the UI must expose the charge as pending rather than failed or settled; only webhook settlement may make the displayed status terminal.

impacts.evidence: The fallback graph connects payments/charge.py to providers/gateway.py; together with the verified timeout-after-capture invariant, retrying with a new key could create a second capture.
The fallback graph connects payments/charge.py to ui/status.py; the verified pre-webhook rendering invariant means an attempt-level failure can be displayed before the authoritative outcome.
Retrying every failed attempt without an attempt bound or delay can loop indefinitely during a provider outage; no repository retry implementation exists yet.
